Name: Illuminate
Effect: This Pokémon and its Allies cannot have their Accuracy Reduced, additionally Moves/Maneuvers they use with Low Accuracy Penalties have +1 Accuracy. Out of Battle this Pokémon produces a 30ft radius of light.
Description: The Pokémon naturally produces a soft and warm light through its body. Other Pokémon approach to it curiously when they see this light.
